note: Third-party tools the bootstrap builds download, pinned by SHA-256. A build fetches Goobster's own copy from the mirror release first and the upstream URL second, and keeps a download only when it matches its pin; otherwise the artifact is skipped with APPIMAGE_SKIPPED (Linux) or INSTALLER_SKIPPED (Windows). Nothing unpinned is ever executed. Pins change only through the procedure in documentation/bootstrap_tools.md: scripts/bootstrap-tools.js verifies a newer upstream build and a person merges the pull request that carries it.

mirror.note: One release that holds a copy of every file pinned below, each named <upstream file name>.<sha256>. A file is uploaded only after its pin is merged, and is never replaced or removed, so reverting a pin keeps working.

appimageRuntime.note: The runtime that mounts the image. Upstream publishes it only as a rolling 'continuous' release that is rebuilt on every push, so the upstream URL serves this build only until the next one; the mirror keeps it. Each file carries upstream's detached signature, checked against the pinned key.

winsw.note: The Windows service host (WinSW, .NET Framework 4.x build: runs on a stock Windows 10/11 and Server 2016+). Upstream publishes no checksum or signature for this release; the hash was computed from the release asset and cross-checked against independent Scoop package manifests that pin the same file. The helper (apps/manager/privileged/win32.js) compares the executable against windowsServiceXml.WINSW before it registers anything; tests/windowsService.test.js keeps the two equal, so a pull request that changes this pin must change that constant too.
